notes.title: Balancing (And bug fixing)
notes.content: [list][*][p]Many bosses have had a difficulty nerf (mostly health related)[/p][/*][*][p]Wave no longer incorrectly plays the damage sound on start[/p][/*][*][p]Gloom now correctly fades in[/p][/*][*][p]Wave & Eclipse now have achievements [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: QOL Mini-update
notes.content: You can now see what character you have equipped, locked characters are more obvious, and there's now a popup to show that there's more bosses.

notes.title: 2 new characters + "new" boss
notes.content: [p]- Fixed bug where Deimos's hurt sound would play immedetly on entering a boss[/p][p]- Added eclipse[/p][p]- Changed "Voidsent" to "Abyss"[/p][p]- Added "Gloom" attack[/p][p]- Added "Wave" character[/p]

notes.title: Deimos + Voidsent
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added new character "Deimos"[/p][/*][*][p]Added new boss "Voidsent"[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed "Listener" a small amount[/p][/*][/list]

[list][*][p]Added “Bolt” character[/p][/*][*][p]“Damage Dealt” stat will no longer go down when healing boss[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Damage pack damage dealt”, “drain damage dealt”, and “Boss health healed” stats[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Listener” boss[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few new tips[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Error” character[/p][/*][/list]

[list][*][p]Added "Alter"[/p][/*][*][p]Deaths are now tracked & visible in the logbook[/p][/*][*][p]Bullseye now acts internally differently and will now work more consistently on different frame rates[/p][list][*][p]Bullseye's speed may be altered from this change[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

Added “Fall” attack
Rain: Left hail => Down Fall
Psionic: Ability changed from “Damage is not dealt over time. Damage packs are twice as common and deal twice as much damage. Can teleport every 3 seconds.” to “3x drain rate. All attacks are sent instantly. Projectiles are doubled. Can teleport every 3 seconds.” Health: 4 => 3. Speed: 35 => 30
Fixed a bug where you could unlock a [i]currently[/i] unused character
Chaos now displays the correct names of bullets added

Added Watcher boss
Added spotlight attack
Removed 2 Smoke Screens from Spectral
Added 1 spotlight to Spectral
Added Smoke Screen to Chaos menu
Bullseye’s stats now correctly display 7 Health

- Added Spectral boss
- Some hit sound effects were changed
- (Hopefully) fixed a bug where resolution was not 1920x1080p causing many UI elements to break
Fixed a bug where Corrupt would be invisible

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content: [p]Added 4 new characters to unlock along with steam achievements for them![/p][p]Unlock Nova, Decay, Angel, and Psionic now![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636371/27ae774d44a19d1daefdbe8314e6721360adc644.png"][/img][/p][p]There's also a new hidden boss, Decay, located somewhere on the main menu! Defeat it to unlock the character Decay.[/p]
